$comment: Workspace O2.1 runner contract inventory (docs/claude-workspace-o2-1-runner-ipc-foundation-brief.md §4). Distinct from contract/workspace/contracts.json (Dashboard-owned workspace orchestration records) and from contract/pin.json / contract/workspace/sensei-pin.json (Sensei-core-pinned contracts) -- this schema is local runner-owned truth, authored and versioned in this repository, not pinned from globulario/sensei. Browser/webview direct access to the runner's transport is prohibited in every phase this contract covers; only a future native/Tauri client may implement the generated consumer type.

contracts.notes: Authenticated HTTP/1.1 over IPv4 loopback only (127.0.0.1), bearer-token authentication via an externally supplied --auth-token-file, no CORS/Origin support. Browser/webview direct access is prohibited by design (docs/claude-workspace-o2-1-runner-ipc-foundation-brief.md §E) -- the server refuses every request carrying an Origin header and every OPTIONS request. O2.1 defines exactly handshake, status, and a non-durable in-memory sequenced event stream; no job, worktree, provider, or Sensei-admission surface exists yet.
